name: Satchel
author: MarshalX
description: One list of everything you own, across every character. Bags, bank and mailbox are recorded as they are read, so an item is one row with a total however many stacks and characters hold it, and hovering says who has how many and where. What a vendor would pay for a bag, a bank and the whole account.

preview.alt: On the left, Everything you own, one row an item, pooled across every character and searchable, sortable and filterable by who holds it, each name coloured by its tier, with what the whole list goes for at the Merchant along the bottom On the right, One character, live, the bags of the character in play, as a grid of squares bordered by item tier, one of them padlocked

companionReasons.lorebind: publishes what every item is called and what a vendor pays, which is what puts a name, a tier and a floor on these rows
companionReasons.ledgerline: publishes what things have been going for at the Merchant, which is what turns a vendor floor into a figure worth reading

keybinds.label: Show or hide the bag panel
